en.name: Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)
en.meta_title: Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL): Natural Buttock Enhancement & Augmentation
en.meta_description: Enhance the size and shape of your buttocks with a Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL). This procedure uses your own fat, harvested via liposuction from other areas, to create a fuller, curvier, and more lifted buttock profile naturally.
en.meta_keywords: brazilian butt lift, BBL, buttock augmentation, fat transfer to buttocks, butt enhancement, body contouring, liposuction, plastic surgery

what_is.heading: What is a Brazilian Butt Lift? Natural Body Contouring
paragraphs: The Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL) is a highly popular and transformative procedure that enhances the size and shape of the buttocks using your own natural fat. It is a two-in-one body contouring surgery that creates a curvier, more lifted buttock profile and a more defined hourglass silhouette.

procedure.heading: The BBL Procedure: Liposuction and Fat Transfer
paragraphs: The procedure begins with liposuction to harvest excess fat from other areas of the body where it is unwanted, such as the abdomen, love handles, or thighs. This has the added benefit of slimming and contouring the donor sites. The harvested fat is then purified and meticulously injected in multiple layers into the buttocks to increase volume, improve shape, and create a lifted appearance.

benefits_recovery.heading: Benefits and Recovery
paragraphs: A BBL is an excellent option for those who desire a fuller posterior but want to avoid implants. Because it uses your own fat, the results look and feel completely natural. Our surgeons are experts in the artistic placement of fat to create beautiful, proportional, and long-lasting results. Recovery requires avoiding direct pressure on the buttocks for several weeks to ensure the optimal survival of the transferred fat cells. The final result is a permanently enhanced and more voluptuous lower body contour.
